build_emissions_graph: build a linear graph from emission probabilities using gtn.linear_graph and set_weights
build_ctc_graph: build a CTC graph with target labels and blank token using gtn.Graph
test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss computation by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward_score
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG loss by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward_score gradients
test_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions with transitions and calling gtn.viterbi_path
